rollStages: Normalize encounter weights and choose a species

surfaceRules.water: Mapped water polygon permits eligible aquatic species with an aquatic trap.
surfaceRules.shore: A separate shore-band context may permit aquatic species at a much lower encounter weight. Illustrative multiplier 0.10; exact distance and value are not approved.
surfaceRules.land: No aquatic candidates when neither mapped water nor a valid shore exception applies.
surfaceRules.unknown: Missing or ambiguous geography must not silently claim water; hold specialized eligibility unresolved or offer a clearly defined ordinary land rule.

capturePolicyProposal.hardVersusSoftRules: Surface/trap compatibility is a candidate hard gate. Biome, POI and time are proposed weighted affinities, allowing broad accessibility. Specific species may later receive hard exclusions, explicitly authored rather than inferred.
capturePolicyProposal.successRateMeaning: Illustrative baseline for discussing the first land prototype, not live economy tuning.
capturePolicyProposal.stackingProposal: Each authored buff applies at most once, even when multiple nearby POIs share the tag. Add probability points to baseline, then clamp. Trap tier and rarity modifiers need their own explicit table before adoption.
capturePolicyProposal.snapshotProposal: Freeze accepted definition revision and resolved habitat/time context with the placed trap; reloads, changing definitions and changing current time must not reroll an accepted assignment.
capturePolicyProposal.seasonWeather: Reserved tags only; no season or weather service is assumed.

questions: Choose the first ordinary-animal and evolution-family subset for runtime adoption; using more than one pack is approved.
Decide whether a water-only species can ever be caught from shore and what the shore band means in meters.
Decide whether region-exclusive species are acceptable or whether later accessible alternatives are needed.
Decide whether very large aquatic models need another trap family; this roster leaves Dolphin and Orca out.
Biome names and time ranges in this proposal are design vocabulary, not proof of an implemented geographic classifier.
taxonomyScope: The broad habitat labels in this roster are prospective ecological concepts, not implemented gameplay biomes. Fantasy biomes are defined independent of real climate; Water is now a habitat within a biome, not its own biome. Do not derive region/climate restrictions or a final biome catalog from these labels.
